human renin is synthesized as a 45 0 0 molecular weight protein in a cell-free protein synthesis system.

a preprorenin mRNA of about 15S was found in human kidney mRNA preparations, and that a 45 500 molecular weight preprorenin was synthesized in a cell free translation system using human mRNA and rabbit reticulocytes.
a pre-prorenin mRNA species of 15S was isolated from human kidney mRNA, and that the 45 000 MW pre-prorenin is synthesized in a reticulocyte cell-free translation system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of mRNA species which code for human renin, and the translation of these mRNA species into renin precursor proteins.
the isolation and translation of mRNA coding for human renin.
the synthesis of human renin precursor in a cell-free system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 45 000 renin precursor has been identified as the ultimate precursor of the renin enzyme.
human pre-prorenin is synthesized in a reticulocyte cell-free system from a 15S mRNA.
renin is synthesized as preprorenin and that the prorenin is the active enzyme.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
renin mRNA is a 15S molecule, renin precursor is a 45 00 molecular weight protein, and the renin precursor is encoded by the 15S renin mRNA species.
the renin precursor is a 45 00 molecular weight protein synthesized from a 15S mRNA species.
the 45 000 precursor protein is synthesized in a human kidney cell-free system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 15S mRNA fraction is the only mRNA species that is able to direct the synthesis of a protein immunopreciptable by the anti-human renin antibody.
the 15S mRNA species, which is responsible for the synthesis of renin precursor, can be translated in a cell-free system.
we can use the reticulocyte system to make renin.
